recording_provenance.skills: Read from the rust-v0.154.0 tag of github.com/openai/codex on 2026-11-03: codex-rs/app-server-protocol/src/protocol/common.rs lists SkillsList => "skills/list" (params SkillsListParams {cwds, forceReload}) and SkillsChanged => "skills/changed", neither behind #[experimental]; protocol/v2/turn.rs's UserInput has Skill {name, path}; protocol/v2/plugin.rs's SkillMetadata has name, description, shortDescription, interface {displayName, shortDescription, ...}, path, scope (user|repo|system|admin), enabled and pluginId. The same in all eight supported versions, so the feature has no version gate (koru-ai D121).
